title: Dynamic Reporting Formula
prompt:
Build a report that updates when the selected region changes.

Skills: Dynamic arrays, FILTER, SORT and UNIQUE.

Use the supplied synthetic CSV at assets/data/practical-17-dynamic-reporting-formula.csv. A small copy/pastable sample is included below in case the CSV is not directly downloadable from the lesson page. Complete the work in a separate .xlsx copy, preserve a raw-data sheet, and check the result against the acceptance criteria. Then answer the short grading check; it does not validate the workbook itself.

Sample CSV (synthetic):
OrderID,Region,Product,Revenue
O1,East,Pen,120
O2,West,Bag,440
O3,East,Notebook,310
objective: Build a report that updates when the selected region changes.

starter.instructions: Open/import the UTF-8 CSV into Excel. Keep the original source data unchanged and perform work on a separate sheet or workbook.

expected_output: Expected: changing the selector updates only matching records; empty matches are handled and spill area remains clear.

public_tests.name: Sample-data acceptance
checklist: Input records are preserved and data types are checked.
Totals/results reconcile with a small independent calculation.
An edge case, duplicate or threshold boundary is tested where relevant.

public_tests.name: Server-side answer check
public_tests.note: A text/choice check does not execute Excel or inspect the workbook artifact.

acceptance_criteria: Expected: changing the selector updates only matching records; empty matches are handled and spill area remains clear.
Use a labeled result area and document formulas, assumptions or transformation steps.
Compare actual results with a manual/independently calculated expected result and test one edge case.
Keep source data intact and request human review of the completed workbook; do not treat the text grader as artifact validation.
hints: Import data without losing dates, decimals or leading zeros.
Separate raw inputs, calculations and presentation outputs.
Test empty inputs, duplicated keys, boundary values or missing matches as appropriate to the scenario.
grading_method: Server-side exact_text check of the submitted answer/expression only; does not execute Excel or inspect the workbook. This workbook-practice task needs a human-reviewed artifact and test evidence for full acceptance. Returns records whose region matches the selector in G1 when dynamic arrays are supported.
retry_policy: Retries are permitted. A failed string/choice submission does not complete the exercise. Course files do not define XP; platform-wide server logic applies.
